description: Conformance manifest for the ACCEPTED FOR IMPLEMENTATION W2-I inference-plane transport-binding example fixtures (v0.1.0, not stable v1/GA; Gate W2-I decided ACCEPT by the Decision Council / Founder at human boundary HB-4 on 2026-08-20). 'kind' drives the expected validation outcome: positive = MUST validate; negative-schema = MUST fail JSON Schema validation; negative-semantic = MUST validate structurally but MUST be rejected by a relying-party trust invariant a schema alone cannot enforce (a fixed test clock NOW=1900000000 makes the token time window deterministic). Schema paths are relative to contracts/json-schema/; fixture paths are relative to contracts/examples/transport/. Validated by tools/contract-validation/validate-transport.mjs; conformance is a consistency signal only and is never itself the acceptance record — acceptance is the recorded HB-4 decision.

examples.note: Safe-read coverage for the model-class health operation (OpenAPI operationId 'getModelClassHealth', GET /api/v1/model-classes/{model_class}/health): GET, requires_idempotency_key false, retriable because is_safe (never because anything is guarded), presented under mTLS (mutual_tls true, peer_cert_thumbprint == token cnf['x5t#S256'] == relying_party.peer_cert_thumbprint) AND a certificate-bound asymmetric at+jwt W2-F delegation token from a pinned issuer. VOCABULARY STATUS: the operation token is 'ai.model_class_health.read' at all three sites (rest_binding.operation.name, token cybrik.operation.name, body_advisory.operation.name). It now AGREES with this candidate's successor OpenAPI x-cybrik-operation-token for the same operationId; the earlier divergent spelling 'ai.model_classes.health_read' was a reconciliation defect and has been corrected here, in favour of the successor bytes. VOCABULARY OBLIGATION CARRIED FORWARD: Gate W2-I is now ACCEPTED (HB-4, 2026-08-20), but that acceptance did NOT amend the ACCEPTED W2-F service-delegation operation-token table, which still names only the two create tokens. 'ai.model_class_health.read' and 'ai.model_classes.list' are therefore accepted W2-I transport vocabulary that the accepted W2-F vocabulary does not yet define. The W2-F amendment is an UNDISCHARGED post-acceptance obligation with its own separate gate and review; until it lands, no delegation token may authorize either read operation. Conformance of this fixture is structural evidence only and grants no W2-F vocabulary acceptance.

examples.invariant: TT-1 mTLS-BOUND: transport.mutual_tls is const true; a bearer-only, non-mTLS inference channel is structurally inexpressible on this seam (ADR-0008 D1).

TT-2 NO FORWARDED USER TOKEN: body_advisory is additionalProperties:false; an 'on_behalf_of_user_token' cannot ride along — delegation is the token's act/actor claim (RFC 8693), never a forwarded end-user credential.

TT-3 NO MODEL/VENDOR/TOOL AUTHORITY: body_advisory is additionalProperties:false; a 'model'/'tools' field is rejected — the transport binding grants no model/vendor/tool/agent authority (ADR-0008 D4; W2-D G-W2D-1).
TT-4 REPLAY CONTROL: idempotency_key minLength 16; a short key is rejected so a create retry cannot be forged short (mirrors W2-D idempotency_key + the Idempotency-Key OpenAPI param).

TT-5 SAFE/IDEMPOTENT RETRY ONLY: retryDisposition if/then makes retriable=true impossible unless is_safe OR idempotency_guarded; a blind retry of a non-safe, non-idempotent operation is structurally rejected.
TT-6 ASYMMETRIC-ONLY TOKEN: the composed W2-F token header.alg is a jwtAlg (asymmetric only); a shared-secret HS256 delegation token is rejected (RFC 8725 §3.1/§3.2).
TT-7 FAIL-CLOSED ERROR: fail_closed is const true; a typed error claiming a soft/partial (fail_closed=false) authorization is structurally impossible.
TT-8 CLOSED STATUS SET: status is the closed enum {400,401,403,409,422,429,503}; a 500 (or any other 5xx) is rejected — fail-closed uniformity, no leaked server error.
TT-9 NO SECRET LEAK: the error is additionalProperties:false; an 'access_token' (or any credential/key) field is rejected — an authorization denial never echoes the secret material that failed.

TX-2 AUDIENCE: relying_party.audience ('svc:soc-notifier') != token.aud ('svc:cyber-ai-inference'). A token presented to any audience other than the validating service MUST be rejected (confused-deputy defense; RFC 9700 §2.3).
TX-1 PROOF-OF-POSSESSION: transport.peer_cert_thumbprint != token cnf['x5t#S256']. A token presented without its bound client certificate MUST be rejected (RFC 8705).
TX-3 CROSS-TENANT: body_advisory.tenant_id ('tenant-globex') != token cybrik.tenant_id ('tenant-acme'). Authoritative tenant is the token; the advisory body never elevates. MUST be rejected.

TX-4 OPERATION BINDING: body_advisory.operation.name ('ai.summarization.create') != token cybrik.operation.name ('ai.inference.create') (and != rest_binding.operation.name). A body requesting an unauthorized operation is a confused-deputy attempt and MUST be rejected.

TX-5 MARKING NON-ESCALATION: body_advisory.data_marking (restricted/TLP:RED) is above token cybrik.marking (confidential/TLP:AMBER) on the classification/TLP lattice. The relying party MUST reject a request above the token ceiling.

TX-6 ORG SCOPE: body_advisory.org_scope ('org:globex/soc/tier1') != token cybrik.org_scope ('org:acme/soc/tier2'). The advisory org hint MUST match the token; it carries no authority on its own (ADR-0007 delta not applied).

TX-8 FEATURE FLAG DEFAULT-OFF: feature_flag.enabled=false yet decision.disposition='permit'. A disabled operation MUST NOT be silently served; the relying party MUST apply disabled_behavior (reject_unavailable / compatibility_passthrough), never permit as if enabled.

TX-7 REPLAY: the presented token reuses jti 'jti-soc-9f8e7d6c5b4a3210' and idempotency_key 'idem-inf-0001-abcdef01' already seen on the positive inference binding. A second presentation MUST be rejected by the relying party's replay/idempotency cache (schema cannot track cross-request state).
